data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in PCYO, ALCO, and LMNR.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot for your team.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
